translation.name: Dillꞌ wen dillꞌ   Kob C̱he   Jesucrístonaꞌ

book.name: Apocalipsis
book.title: Jesucrístona' bliile' Juanna' c̱he diika' zi' gak

content: Na' ble'id' yabana' sto dii wal, dii chonan ka yibanicho. Ble'id' gall anjl, beṉ'ka' nak lall' na'gake' wisgake' zi gall yeḻ' zak'zi'ka' gat' lo yell-lioni kwenc̱he yiyoll yido yeḻ' chllaa c̱he Chioza'.

Na' ḻekzka' ble'id' daa nak ka nisdo' de vidr nc̱hix̱an yi'. Na' ble'id' beṉ'ka' bizo bizaki bi be'la'ogake' bayix̱aa na' lwaa lsak'ba' na' bi be'gake' latj sho'gake' seṉ c̱heba', zegake' cho'a nisdo' de vidra' na' nox̱'gake' twej arpa daa be' Chioza' ḻegake'.
Na' choḻgake' to dii beḻ dii Moiséza', beena' ben ka cheeni Chioza', na' daa beḻ Jesucrístona', Beena' Zaklebi to Xil'do', nagake':

content.text: Ḻe nak diika' chono' na' chongakan ka chibaninto',
Chios, beṉ' nak X̱annto', beṉ' yeḻ' wak choo yeḻ' wak xen.
Yog' diika' chono', chono'n ka chiyaḻ',
li' nako' beṉ' wṉabia' c̱he yog' beṉ' yell-lio.
Biga zoa beṉ' bi gall illebe' li', X̱an'.
Biga zoa beṉ' bi kwe' li' balaaṉ.
Ḻa' tozo' lin' nako' dowalj beṉ' ḻi beṉ' shao'.
Na' beṉ'ka' lle' doxen yell-lioni yidgake' we'la'ogake' li',
daa ble'gakile' diika' chono' nakan shḻicha.

content: Na' ka biyoll dga, bizle'id' byalj yoodo' c̱he Chioza' yabana', latj gana' yooshao' ley c̱he Chioza' daa bzeje' ḻee yaj taaka'.

Na' ḻoo yoodo'na' bchej gall anjl, beṉ'ka' nak lall' na'gake' wisgake' gall yeḻ' zak'zi'ka' gat' lo yell-liona'. Nakwgake' twej lech' xtil dii chey cheeni' na' ngoo ḻi'eka' twej bad' de or bllinten ka de cho'alc̱ho'eka'te.
Na' to beṉ'ka' tap, beṉ'ka' zoa x̱ilinna', bi'e to to anjlka' twej kop de or nakgakan tolla' yeḻ' zak'zi' c̱he Chioza', beena' zoa zejḻi kaṉi.

Na' ḻoo yoodo'na' gokan tolla' llenna' ni c̱heyi balaaṉ xen c̱he Chioza' na' yeḻ' wak choo yeḻ' wak xen c̱he'na'. Na' kono gok yiyoo ḻoo yoodo'na' ax̱t ki biyoll bido gallte yeḻ' zak'zi'ka' daa nak lo na' anjlka' gall.
